title: QC gate test clean pattern
subtitle: A complete fixture that should publish.
excerpt: A throwaway fixture with real row instructions used to prove the completeness gate lets complete patterns through to PUBLISHED.

crochet.gaugeText: 16 dc x 20 rows = 10 x 10 cm in DK with a 4 mm hook.
crochet.finishedSizeText: About 20 cm wide; length to taste.

content.text: This is a throwaway test fixture with real, makeable instructions, used to prove the completeness gate lets a complete pattern through to PUBLISHED rather than over-blocking good content.
Row 1: double crochet in the second chain from the hook and in each chain across. Turn. (20 sts)
Row 2: chain 1, double crochet in each stitch across. Turn. (20 sts)
Repeat Row 2 until the work measures 20 cm. Fasten off and weave in the ends.
